testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.services.KeyRotationServiceTest

testcase.name: an unknown identity is reported rather than rotating something else()
the status list cache is not invalidated when nothing was rotated()
nothing is recorded when the library rotation fails()
an identity from another trust space cannot be rotated()
a did-key identity is refused, because its key is its identifier()
the current verification method comes from the directory()
